attempted_claim: For a general ordinary Gushel-Mukai threefold X and the primitive Kuznetsov class v1=[pr(O_x)], the tilt-stability wall W1 defined by slope equality at beta=-1 with alpha>0 admits no strictly tilt-semistable object of the lifted class: every tilt-semistable object of that class on the stated side is tilt-stable and hence Serre-invariant Bridgeland stable, unless the explicit rank-one destabilizing sequence with logged Chern data cuts out W1 as the sharp wall.
claim_type: tilt-wall stability-gap classification fragment with stable-object existence witness
decisive_failure: No verified lifted Chern character of pr(O_x): c2(U^vee), h0(U^vee) with vanishings, and mutation order remain unconfirmed. No explicit Li-type generalized Bogomolov-Gieseker boundary for GM threefolds of degree 10 was available, so rank-one numerical slope equality stays infinite (2453 small-height solutions). No beta=-1 heart/Hom criterion was closed, so neither empty-wall stability nor a sharp destabilizer could be certified.
